info.name: CollabSpace - Authentication API
info.description:
Production-grade Authentication API collection for CollabSpace REST API under /api/v1/auth.

Includes Email/Password registration & login, Remember Me (24h vs 30d tokens), Logout, User Profile (/me), Google OAuth Sign-in & Sign-up, Google Account Linking, and Password Reset.

request.description: Register a new user account. Automatically authenticates the user and returns an immediate 24-hour Sanctum Bearer token. Public registration always creates accounts with role 'user'.

response.name: 201 Created
422 Validation Error

request.description: Authenticate user with email and password. When remember=false, returns a Personal Access Token with a lifetime of 24 hours (86,400s).

response.name: 200 Success
401 Invalid Credentials

request.description: Authenticate user with email, password, and remember=true. Issues a Personal Access Token with a lifetime of 30 days (2,592,000s).

response.name: 200 Success

request.description: Revokes only the current Personal Access Token used in Authorization header. Other device sessions remain active.
Returns safe account data for the currently authenticated user. Requires valid Bearer Token and non-suspended account status.
Initiates Google OAuth. Generates a secure random state with a 5-minute cache TTL and redirects the browser to accounts.google.com consent screen.

Google OAuth redirects the browser back to this backend callback endpoint.

Backend validates state atomically, retrieves verified Google profile, creates account or loads existing Google user, generates a 64-char one-time exchange code, and redirects browser to FRONTEND_AUTH_CALLBACK_URL with `#code={exchange_code}`.
Frontend extracts the `#code` from URL fragment and sends it via POST to exchange it atomically for a 24-hour Sanctum Bearer token. Replaying or reusing codes is strictly rejected.

response.name: 200 Success
401 Invalid or Replayed Code

request.description: Authenticated user initiates Google account linking. Backend binds the authenticated user ID into a secure state stored in cache (5-min TTL) and redirects to Google.

Google redirects back to this endpoint. Backend validates state from cache, extracts the initiating user ID safely from server-side state, links the verified Google identity, and redirects to FRONTEND_LINK_CALLBACK_URL with `#status=linked_success` or `#error=...`.
Sends a password reset link expiring in 60 minutes. Always returns a generic response regardless of whether the email is registered to prevent user enumeration.

response.name: 200 Generic Success

request.description: Resets the user's password using the single-use token. Enforces the 12-char mixed/numbers/symbols password policy. Revokes all active Personal Access Tokens for that user across all devices.

response.name: 200 Success
422 Invalid / Expired Token
